en: I'm sorry. Clair, our Leader, has gone into the Dragon's Den behind the Gym, and nobody knows when she'll be back.
Clair is waiting for challengers. Just don't expect an ordinary trainer to stand a chance against her.
You beat Clair? That's incredible! I've never heard of anyone doing that except Lance.
No, no. Only trainers who have been chosen may go into the Den. Please turn back.
If Clair agrees to it, so will her grandfather, our elder. Go on in.
